Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Extender of the shadow
Had You willed, You could have made it still
And You made the sun a guide to it
Then You withdraw it to Yourself with an easy withdrawal
O Possessor of generosity and power
And majesty and bounties
There is no god but You
Knower of the unseen and the witnessed
The Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful
There is no god but You
O Holy One, O Peace
O Granter of security, O Guardian
O Mighty, O Compeller
O Supreme, O Allah

Arabic text: يَا خَالِقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ
Translation: O Creator, O Maker, O Fashioner

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah
To You belong the most beautiful names
And the highest examples
And the majesty and bounties

Arabic text: اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِيْ السُّعَدَاءِ
Translation: And to make my name, on this night, among the fortunate
And my soul among the martyrs
And my good deeds in the highest places
And my misdeeds forgiven

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِينًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي
Translation: And that You grant me certainty with which my heart is comforted
And faith that removes doubt from me
And make me content with what You have apportioned for me
And grant us good in this world
And good in the Hereafter
And protect us from the punishment of the burning fire

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And grant me in it Your remembrance, gratitude to You, and desire for You

Arabic text: وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: And repentance and success in what You granted success to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, peace be upon him and them
